history_summary.value: The Potchefstroom Koekoek was developed in the 1960s by Chris Marais at the Potchefstroom Agricultural College by crossing Black Australorp, White Leghorn and Barred Plymouth Rock stock to create a dual-purpose bird suited to South African free-range conditions. It keeps a barred black-and-white pattern and can be sexed at hatch.
